picked.t: Ho Chi Minh City in need of 70,000 skilled workers to build its metro network
picked.body: Potential human resources Under the southern metropolis's urban railway development plan for the next five years, it aims to complete six metro lines with a combined length of 187 km, and by 2035, put 14 lines totaling 462 km into operation. Metro Line No. 2 (Ben Thanh–Tham Luong) is scheduled for completion and operation in 2030, alongside priority projects including the extensions of Metro Line No. 1 (the New Binh Duong City–Suoi Tien section) and Metro Line No. 2 (Thu Dau Mot City–Ho Chi Minh City section), Metro Line No. 3 (Vung Tau–Ba Ria–Phu My), and Metro Line No. 6 – the inner ring line (Phu Huu–Ba Queo–Phu Lam roundabout–Phu Huu), with a total length of 180 km. Le Minh Triet, Director of Ho Chi Minh City Urban Railway Company No. 1 (HURC1), said that simply putting the city's first metro line into operation required hundreds to as many as 1,000 workers across various specialized fields. As the city invests in multiple "backbone" metro lines in the coming period, the demand for human resources will grow exponentially. To operate Metro Line No. 1 (Ben Thanh–Suoi Tien), the operator currently employs 700 people to keep nearly 200 train trips running each day. According to HURC1, these personnel work in areas including station operations, station management, train driving, train control and maintenance. Recently, HURC1 announced the recruitment of personnel to undergo training and receive technology transfer for the operation and maintenance of the Phu Quoc LRT railway line. The company said a total of 168 positions are to be recruited, including 130 operations personnel and 38 maintenance workers. They require university, college or equivalent qualifications in relevant fields. Cooperation in training, mastering railway technologies Under the human resources training scheme serving the development of the urban railway network approved by the municipal People’s Committee, the city will need around 70,000 workers by 2030 to support investment in and development of its metro system, including project management personnel, operations and maintenance staff, engineers, technical workers, consultants and designers. Of this total, around 30,000 workers will be needed for operations, maintenance and technical positions, while approximately 12,000 will be required for construction. The economic hub has also drawn up a training plan for 2030–2045, with nearly twice as many personnel as needed in the 2025–2030 period, in line with plans to develop and invest in a metro network of up to 700 km. These requirements are prompting universities and research institutes to prioritize the training of high-quality specialized engineers, particularly in smart transportation. The aim is to prepare a generation of engineers with systematic thinking capable of anticipating a wave of "billion-dollar" infrastructure projects and addressing the human-resource "thirst" amid major infrastructure developments. Nguyen Quoc Trung, Deputy General Director of Dai Quang Minh Real Estate Investment JSC under THACO – the general contractor carrying out the Metro Line No. 2 package, said human resources training and standardization must be prioritized and regarded as a decisive factor as Vietnam cannot remain dependent on foreign contractors for technology and construction solutions. Therefore, mastering the technologies used to build urban railway lines is a priority for THACO, which is also preparing the necessary conditions to develop the domestic railway industry. Recently, the local Management Authority for Urban Railways (MAUR) and the Global Technology-Telecommunications Corporation (GTEL) held a ceremony to sign a memorandum of understanding on cooperation in system integration research and technology transfer for the urban railway network. The immediate focus of the joint work is on research and implementation for Metro Line No. 2 and other urban railway projects to be carried out during 2026–2030. At the same time, the parties will gradually study, receive and master technologies for subsystems including telecommunications, signaling, power, electrical and mechanical (E&M) systems, supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA), the operations control center (OCC), automatic fare collection (AFC) systems, and platform screen doors (PSD).

기사 이해를 돕기위해 AI를 활용해 제작한 이미지입니다. 베트남 채용 시장이 아시아·태평양 및 중동 지역에서 오는 4분기 전망이 가장 낙관적인 시장 중 하나로 떠올랐다. 다만, 베트남 내 기업들은 여전히 적합한 기술을 갖춘 인력 부족을 호소하고 있다. 국제 고용서비스 업체 맨파워그룹(ManpowerGroup)의 최신 고용 전망 조사에 따르면 베트남의 ‘순고용전망(net employment outlook, NEO)’ 지수는 전분기 대비 8%포인트 오른 36%를 기록했다. 이는 아시아·태평양 및 중동 내 3위에 해당하는 수치로, 해당 지역 평균(33%)과 세계 평균(29%)을 모두 웃도는 수준이다. 구체적으로 조사에 참여한 베트남 기업 285곳 중 52%는 4분기 인력을 늘릴 계획이라고 답했고, 16%는 인력 감축을 예상했으며 32%는 인력 규모에 변화가 없을 것으로 내다봤다. 채용 확대의 주된 이유는 사업 확장으로, 인력 확대 계획을 밝힌 기업의 52%가 이를 꼽았다. 업종별로는 정보통신(IT) 부문의 채용 전망이 10%포인트 오른 64%로 가장 높게 나타났고, 지역별로는 북부 지역이 41%로 가장 높았다. 기업 규모별로는 직원 50~249명 기업의 전망치가 49%로 가장 강했다. 기업들은 신입 인재에 대해서도 개방적인 태도를 보였는데, 응답 기업 중 57%가 지난해보다 신입 채용을 늘렸다고 답했다. 특히 정보통신 부문에서는 이 비율이 77%에 달했다. 또한 기업들이 디지털 전환을 가속화함에 따라 STEM(과학·기술·공학·수학) 인재에 대한 수요가 증가하고 있었는데, 특히 △엔지니어링 △인공지능(AI) 모델·앱 개발 △정보기술 △데이터 관련 직군에 대한 수요가 강하게 나타났다. 다만 기업들은 적격 인재를 찾는 데 여전히 어려움을 겪고 있었다. 기업의 약 절반은 적합한 기술을 갖춘 지원자가 부족한 것이 채용 과정이 길어지는 주된 이유라고 답했으며, 43%는 지원자의 기대치와 실제 직무 요건 간 불일치를 문제로 꼽았다. 자동화 역시 노동 수요 변화를 이끄는 요인 중 하나다. 채용 축소를 계획 중인 기업 중 52%는 자동화로 인한 특정 직무 수요 감소를 이유로 꼽았는데, 이는 해당 지역 평균(24%)과 세계 평균(22%)의 2배가 넘는 수준이다. 또한 기업 10곳 중 4곳은 경제 여건의 어려움이 인력계획에 부정적인 영향을 미치고 있다고 답해 경제적 압박도 채용상 어려움 중 하나로 확인됐다. 이 밖에도 AI는 채용 담당자들에게 또 다른 과제를 안기고 있다. AI가 기업의 생산성 향상을 이끌어낼 수 있는 도구이나, 최근 AI를 활용한 입사지원서 작성이 늘면서 기업들이 지원자를 효과적으로 선별하기가 더 어려워지고 있다는 설명이다. 연말을 앞두고 베트남 노동 시장이 경쟁이 한층 치열해지고 있는 가운데 기업들의 경쟁력은 갈수록 얼마나 많은 인력을 채용할 수 있느냐가 아니라, AI와 자동화로 빠르게 변화하는 직무에 필요한 기술을 갖춘 인력을 확보할 수 있느냐에 달려 있는 것으로 보인다.

picked.t: China welcomes 23 million visa-free foreign tourists in 8 months
picked.body: China's immigration authorities recorded 499 million inbound and outbound passenger trips during this period, a 8.7% increase from the previous year, Global Times reported. An official from the National Immigration Administration stated that recent measures have made it easier for foreign nationals to visit China, significantly cutting clearance times for travelers at ports of entry, Xinhua News Agency reported. Last year, China extended its visa-free entry for 45 countries, many in Europe, South America and the Gulf region besides Australia, New Zealand, Japan, and South Korea, until the end of 2026, AP reported. The Chinese government plans to continue improving immigration policies and border inspection procedures, enhancing government services and speeding up clearance for tourists. China recently added Kyrgyzstan and Vietnam to its 240-hour visa-free transit program, bringing the total number of countries eligible for this policy to 57. Effective from Aug. 20, citizens of these countries holding ordinary passports and interline passenger tickets with confirmed dates and itineraries bound for a third country or region may enter China through any of the 65 ports across the country and stay up to 240 hours, or 10 days, without a visa, according to the National Immigration Administration.

picked.t: 베트남 중앙銀, ‘연준 FOMC’ 앞두고 기준환율 인상…2만5,617동 ‘사상 최고치’
picked.body: 기사 이해를 돕기위해 AI를 활용해 제작한 이미지입니다. 베트남중앙은행(SBV)이 15~16일 열릴 미국 연방준비제도(Fed·연준)의 9월 연방공개시장위원회(FOMC)를 앞두고 기준환율을 사상 최고치인 2만5,617동으로 인상했다. 15일 오전 베트남중앙은행은 달러/동(USD/VND) 기준환율을 전일 대비 10동 오른 2만5,617동으로 고시했다. 이는 지난달 말과 이달 초 기록했던 2만5,615동보다 2동 높은 것으로 사상 최고치에 해당한다. 중앙은행은 △은행 간 시장 환율 △주요 교역국 통화 가치 △거시경제 균형 및 정책 목표 등을 종합하여 기준 환율을 매일 고시한다. 베트남 각 은행은 기준 환율 기준 ±5% 변동 폭 내 마진을 붙여 달러를 사고 팔 수 있다. 지난 2주간 진정세를 보였던 기준환율이 큰 폭으로 오른 것은 15~16일 FOMC 회의가 예정돼 있기 때문으로 풀이된다. 국내외 여러 기관들은 연준이 기준금리를 25bp 추가 인상할 가능성에 베팅하고 있는데, 이는 2023년 이후 첫 인상이 될 전망이다. 유안타증권베트남 분석팀은 전일 발표한 통화 보고서를 통해 "연준의 결정은 이번 주 달러인덱스(DXY)와 달러/동 환율을 좌우할 주된 요인"이라고 분석했다. 베트남 4대 국영상업은행 중 하나인 비엣틴은행(VietinBank) 외환영업센터 또한 “연준의 금리 결정 발표 시점을 전후해 시장이 크게 출렁일 수 있다”고 전망했다. 연준이 예상보다 매파적인 메시지를 낼 경우 달러 강세가 더 확대될 가능성이 있다는 설명이다. 한편, 이날 은행권 환율 역시 기준환율과 비슷한 흐름을 보였다. 비엣틴은행과 비엣콤은행(Vietcombank), 베트남수출입은행(Eximbank)은 매수 2만5,810동, 매도 2만6,220동 등 매수·매도 환율을 20~40동 범위로 인상했다. 암시장 환율도 소폭 상승했다. 현재 호치민시의 일부 환전소 달러 매수·매도가는 각각 2만5,700동, 2만6,000동으로 주초 대비 30동가량 올랐다.

picked.t: Tropical depression hits central Vietnam, threatening widespread flooding and landslides
picked.body: Authorities in the central region have been getting ready to respond to the tropical depression that made landfall on Sunday evening, after heavy rain in several areas caused flooding and landslides over the weekend. By early Sept. 14, it is over inland coastal areas of Ha Tinh Province and northern Quang Tri, with sustained winds at 39-74 km per hour, according to the National Center for Hydrometeorological Forecasting (NCHMF). The NCHMF said that the depression would continue moving west-northwest at about 10 km per hour, passing through Quang Tri and Ha Tinh into central Laos and gradually weakening to a low-pressure system. Although not particularly intense, the tropical depression was expected to bring rain over a very large area, covering many provinces and cities in the north and central regions. Affected localities in the central region include Thanh Hoa, Nghe An, Ha Tinh, Quang Tri, Hue and Da Nang. In the north, affected areas include the midlands and deltas of the northern region and the southern parts of Son La, Phu Tho, Tuyen Quang and Lao Cai provinces. The disaster risk level is assessed at level three out of five. Under the influence of the tropical depression, sea areas from southern Nghe An to Hue City are expected to experience strong winds and rough seas, with waves of up to 4 m. These hazardous conditions could capsize, sink or damage fishing vessels, cargo ships, tourist boats and other seagoing craft. Aquaculture cages, mooring areas and coastal structures are also at risk of damage. Offshore fishing, maritime transport and tourism activities are likely to be disrupted. On Sept. 15, the midlands and deltas of the northern region, the southern parts of Son La, Phu Tho, Tuyen Quang and Lao Cai provinces, as well as Thanh Hoa, Nghe An, Ha Tinh and Quang Tri will see moderate to heavy rain and thunderstorms, with rainfall typically ranging from 30-60mm and potentially exceeding 100mm in some places. The heavy rain event is likely to persist in these areas until Sept. 16 morning. Owing to prolonged heavy rainfall, the NCHMF warns of a very high risk of flash floods and landslides in mountainous regions and widespread inundation in low-lying areas of Thanh Hoa, Nghe An, Ha Tinh, Quang Tri and Hue. Storms ongoing Isolated heavy rain on Sept. 12 evening caused water levels to rise rapidly in many parts of Da Nang, leading to localized flooding and potential safety risks for residents. Reports indicate that in Da Son 8 residential group and along Me Suot Street in Hoa Khanh Ward, water rose quickly overnight. Functional forces urgently evacuated residents from deeply flooded areas during the night. In several mountainous districts in the west of Quang Tri Province, localized flooding and isolation occurred at bridges, overflowing weirs and roads, including in La Lay, Dakrong, Ba Long, A Doi, Huong Lap, Huong Son, Lia and Lao Bao communes. Prolonged heavy rain also caused the Se Pon River to rise, flooding Lao Bao Commune. Functional forces relocated nearly 60 households to safety. On National Highway 15D, in the section passing through La Lay Commune, heavy rain triggered embankment landslides, with soil and rocks spilling onto the road surface and causing a complete blockage. Provincial Road 588 through Ba Long Commune and provincial road 586 in A Doi Commune experienced flooded sections, impeding travel. On the Ho Chi Minh Road section through Ta Rut Commune, a landslide caused around 200 cu.m of soil and rocks to spill onto the road, blocking traffic and preventing vehicles from passing. Ta Rut Commune police deployed personnel to regulate traffic, whereas relevant units mobilized equipment to clear debris and open a temporary passage for vehicles. In Ba Long Commune, many bridges and overflowing weirs were deeply submerged, with some weirs flooded to depths of up to 3m. Local authorities installed warning signs and stationed guards to restrict residents and vehicles from entering hazardous areas. Given the complex development of rain and floods, the Ba Long People's Committee directed police and military forces to remain on the ground, raise awareness, implement disaster prevention and search-and-rescue plans, and carry out evacuation measures for people in flooded areas. Across the commune, 107 households comprising 331 people, mainly the elderly, women and children in areas at risk of landslides and deep flooding, were relocated to safety. Lieutenant Colonel Tran Duy Hung, deputy head of the La Lay Border Guard Post, said: "At present, it is still raining very heavily. River and stream levels are rising sharply, causing fast-flowing water over flooded bridges in the area." At kilometer 9+800 on National Highway 15D, there has been an embankment landslide, with around 50 cu.m of soil and rocks spilling onto the road surface. picked.t: 인사이드비나·한양대 산학협력단, 베트남 인재양성 위한 업무협약 체결
picked.body: 베트남 전문 미디어 인사이드비나가 한양대학교 산학협력단과 업무협약을 진행했다. 인사이드비나와 한양대학교 산학협력단 CI 베트남 전문 미디어 인사이드비나가 한양대학교 산학협력단과 손잡고 국내 외국인 유학생들의 취·창업 역량 강화와 안정적인 한국 사회 정주를 지원하기 위한 상호 협력체계를 구축한다. 인사이드비나는 한양대학교 산학협력단과 ‘서울시 지역성장 인재양성체계(앵커, ANCHOR)’ 구축을 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 체결했다고 15일 밝혔다. 이번 협약은 서울시 앵커 사업의 일환으로, 한양대에 재학 중인 외국인 유학생들이 학업을 마친 후 한국 사회에 안정적으로 정착할 수 있도록 실질적인 취업 및 창업 지원 프로그램을 공동 개발·운영하기 위해 마련됐다. 양 기관은 이번 협약을 통해 ▲외국인 유학생 대상 취·창업 지원 프로그램 공동 기획 및 운영 ▲기업 및 정부 네트워크를 활용한 취업 연계 프로그램 활성화 ▲글로벌 우수 인재 발굴과 정주 여건 조성을 위한 산학협력 모델 구축 등 다양한 분야에서 긴밀히 협력해 나갈 방침이다. 특히 인사이드비나는 보유하고 있는 베트남 비즈니스 네트워크와 미디어 전문성을 바탕으로 유학생들에게 실질적인 산업 동향과 진로 멘토링을 적극 제공할 예정이다. 인사이드비나 오정희 대표는 “이번 협약은 우수한 외국인 청년 인재들이 한국 사회의 당당한 구성원으로 안착하고, 한국과 베트남을 잇는 경제적 가교 역할을 할 수 있도록 돕는 뜻깊은 출발점”이라며 “단순한 교류를 넘어 유학생들이 체감할 수 있는 실질적인 커리어 성장 발판을 지속적으로 마련하겠다”고 밝혔다. 한편, 양 기관은 이번 업무협약의 첫 프로젝트로 오는 18일(금) 오후 6시 한양대학교 국제관 1층 H라운지에서 한양대 학부 및 대학원에 재학 중인 베트남 유학생을 대상으로 ‘베트남 유학생 취·창업 토크 콘서트’를 공동 개최한다.

picked.t: Food reality show debuts at Vietnam iContent 2026
picked.body: Food reflects the natural environment, customs and knowledge passed down through generations, from local ingredients and cooking methods to seasoning and dining traditions. These elements form the basis of "Sao Chon," a food-focused reality show debuting as part of Vietnam iContent 2026. Running from August to November, the show comprises 10 episodes of around 40 minutes each, featuring artists, influencers, inspirational figures and popular hosts. The journey exploring local cuisine from northern to southern Vietnam features dishes and destinations selected and introduced by the Vietnam Chefs Association for Vocational Training and Employment (VICA), together with artists and celebrities. Unlike conventional food review programs, "Sao Chon" uses cuisine to explore local culture, people and regional values. Each episode introduces regional specialties and their original flavors, along with the people working to preserve local culinary traditions. Cultural activities and local experiences are also incorporated into the journeys. The program follows three steps: Step 1: Nomination Chefs from VICA, together with participating artists and celebrities, nominate two to three dishes and corresponding destinations. The selections cover three categories: street food, home-style cuisine and fine dining. Step 2: Experience Guests visit around two to three selected locations in each destination to sample signature dishes, meet restaurant owners, chefs and others working in the culinary field, and hear the stories behind the food. Step 3: Recognition At the end of each journey, a guest representative presents a "Sao Chon" commemorative award to the nominated restaurant or venue, based on the destination's flavors, quality, cultural identity and contribution to preserving local culinary heritage. Organizers will announce the 10 provinces and cities featured in the journey, along with the participating artists and hosts. All 10 episodes will be available on the "Sao Chon" landing page under VnExpress's Travel section and across multiple digital platforms. According to organizers, the show aims to promote appreciation of Vietnam's culture and local communities, foster national pride, encourage an experience-oriented lifestyle, and introduce Vietnam and its culture to domestic and international audiences. The series also supports the implementation of Politburo Resolution No. 80 on developing Vietnamese culture, including efforts to promote national cultural values and the image of Vietnam and its people through digital platforms. "Sao Chon" is organized by the Authority of Broadcasting and Electronic Information in coordination with VnExpress, FPT Online Services Joint Stock Company (FPT Online), VICA and other participating organizations, alongside Vietnam iContent 2026. Vietnam Technological and Commercial Joint Stock Bank (Techcombank) is the strategic partner, while T Production handles production and communications. Vietnam iContent is an annual program under the direction of the Ministry of Culture, Sports, and Tourism and jointly organized by the Authority of Broadcasting and Electronic Information, FPT Online and VnExpress. Organizers expect the event series to connect content creators, government agencies and businesses to exchange views, contribute to policy development and explore the potential of Vietnam's digital content industry. Techcombank OneU loyalty program Positioned around the message "Multi-tiered rewards, optimized benefits," Techcombank OneU aims to provide additional value to Techcombank's loyal customers across their everyday financial transactions and spending. The program allows users to earn and redeem reward points for a range of spending needs, including travel, dining, entertainment, and healthcare. Users can connect the app with Techcombank Mobile to access additional benefits, including voucher packages worth up to VND300,000 (US$11.53). The Techcombank OneU app is available through the program's official download channel.

picked.t: Ba Na Hills launches Mid-Autumn Festival activities, offers 50% youth discount
picked.body: During the main festival period from Sept. 23 to 25, corresponding to the 13th to 15th days of the eighth lunar month, lion and dragon dances will welcome visitors at the Main Citadel Gate. The performances aim to recreate traditional Mid-Autumn celebrations for Vietnamese visitors while introducing local festive culture to international tourists. Cable Car Station No. 8 will be decorated with traditional and star-shaped lanterns and colorful banners. Over the three festival days, 1,500 complimentary lanterns will be distributed to children at the arrival station. From Sept. 19 to 25, Four Seasons Restaurant will feature a mooncake counter and seasonal dishes. Le Petrin and Rosa Coffee will offer tea-and-pastry combinations, while Maison Eric Kayser will serve high-tea sets incorporating Mid-Autumn flavors. At night, the Moon Garden at Lunar Castle will feature an illuminated full-moon installation against the castle architecture, providing a photo setting for visitors. Beyond the seasonal program, visitors can explore other attractions, including the Golden Bridge and the "Origin" interactive lighting exhibition, which features seven themed zones with lighting effects that respond to visitors' movements. Daily street performances include international acts such as Malambo, Cancan and "Love in the Sky." Other attractions include the French Village and Eclipse Square, while the double-track Alpine Coaster and Fantasy Park offer additional entertainment. Alongside the Mid-Autumn Festival program, the site is continuing its FIRST 18-25 promotion through Dec. 31, 2026. Visitors born between 2001 and 2008 can present a valid citizen ID card, passport or verification through the VNeID app to purchase a cable car ticket for VND500,000. Cable car and lunch buffet packages cost VND800,000, while a cable car ticket with a food voucher costs VND750,000. The promotion offers discounts of up to 50% compared with standard prices. Eligible tickets also include dining benefits through an integrated QR code. Visitors can redeem the benefit for one of three French pastries at Maison Eric Kayser or two 250 ml glasses of craft beer at Ba Na Brew House. The combination of Mid-Autumn Festival activities and the youth ticket promotion is intended to attract families and younger travelers to Ba Na Hills during the September holiday period.

picked.t: From dating app to marriage: Russian woman builds new life with Vietnamese husband
picked.body: In November 2025, Anh, 28, an electrician and plumber for a construction company in Ho Chi Minh City, was assigned to a site about 30 km from Nha Trang. Lonely in unfamiliar surroundings, he turned to a dating app for company. He matched with Anastasiia Nikitina, known as Nastya, a 27-year-old woman from Moscow traveling in Vietnam. They relied on translation tools to hold halting conversations in English. A few days later, they decided to meet in person. "I was attracted to his appearance, even though he wasn’t very tall," she says. She took a liking to him immediately. Anh was, on the other hand, less certain at first. Her smoking, tattoos, and piercings initially put him off, but as they spent more time together, he found her far more sensitive than her appearance had led him to expect. They found common ground in painful childhood experiences that had forced them to grow up early. During one outing, they came across a snake trapped in netting beside the road. He warned her to keep away in case it was venomous, but she insisted on rescuing it. He went down the mountain to borrow a knife, covered the snake’s head with his shirt, cut it free and released it somewhere safe. "I saw in her a deep compassion," he says. From then on, his feelings for her began to change. Whenever he had time, he rode his motorbike 30 km from the construction site into the city to show Nastya the city. Still, he told himself, they were only friends. He felt self-conscious about his slight build, dark complexion and a job that kept him constantly on the move. She was "doll-like, tall and fair" and had a university degree in management and a steady job. Sensing that his feelings ran deeper, Nastya once asked him directly: "Do you like me?" He initially stayed silent. After she pressed him several more times, he admitted to his affection. But she turned him down, saying "I don’t like people who are vague and afraid to say how they really feel." He deleted the dating app, hoping to cut contact and move on. But, two days later, missing Nastya, he reinstalled it and found a message waiting for him: "I’m sick. I want to see you." That night, he bought food and fruits and rode his motorbike down from the hills into the city. He peeled the fruits for Nastya in her room and left. The visit marked the start of their romance. "I trust someone who doesn’t abandon me in times of sickness," she says. Later that month, Nha Trang was hit by severe flooding. The area where Anh worked was cut off for nearly five days without electricity, running water, or phone service. Nastya was staying in the city center, where the floodwaters receded more quickly. Both worried about the other’s safety. As soon as the water began to recede, he set off on his motorbike to find her. Many roads remained under more than a meter of water, forcing him to repeatedly go back and forth and doubling his usual travel time. When they were finally reunited, she embraced him and cried, saying: "I was so worried about you. I missed you so much." After the flooding ended, they moved in together. Their relationship had barely begun when his company reassigned him to Ho Chi Minh City. When he broke the news, she replied: "I’ll go with you wherever you go." After two weeks in Ho Chi Minh City, she suggested moving to Da Nang, drawn by the sea and better career prospects. He resigned his job so that they could begin a new life there together. Several colleagues urged him to reconsider because the couple had known each other only briefly. Some even suspected he was being scammed. Meanwhile, she returned to Russia to obtain proof she was single so they could marry. Her family did not approve when she told them about the relationship. "But after everything we had been through together, we trusted our hearts," she explains. In early 2026, the couple moved to Da Nang and rented an old house a 20-minute walk from the beach. It was damp and moldy, with crumbling walls, but it gave Nastya what she wanted: a home near the sea. Around the Lunar New Year, which fell in February that year, they began renovating the house themselves. He stripped away the damaged sections, replastered the walls and repainted the house. She helped every step of the way, despite her unfamiliarity with heavy manual work. "People around us said it made no sense to put so much effort into fixing a rental," Nguyen Anh said. "But if she couldn’t feel comfortable there, it would be difficult for us to be happy." In July 2026, after resolving a slew of paperwork problems, they married and opened a Russian bakery. She handled the baking, while he sourced ingredients and dealt with customers. Their cultural differences and the language barrier caused occasional friction: For instance, she would want praise and encouragement, while he would express his love more through actions. Over time, they learned to meet each other halfway. He learned to put his feelings into words and taped an English alphabet chart above their bed

picked.t: ‘귀신의 달’ 베트남, 신차 판매량 ‘뚝’…8월 4.8만 대 연중 두 번째 최저치
picked.body: 호치민시의 한 자동차용품 전시전에 참가한 빈패스트의 전기차 VF6.  지난 8월 베트남의 신차 판매량이 4만8,000대 수준으로 급감한 것으로 나타났다. 이는 뗏(Tet 설)으로 긴 연휴가 포함됐던 지난 2월에 이어 연중 두 번째로 저조한 실적으로, 업계는 음력 7월 ‘귀신의 달’이 소비 심리에 부정적인 영향을 미친 것으로 풀이했다. 현대차 베트남 조립·판매업체 현대탄꽁(HTV)과 베트남자동차제조업협회(VAMA), 빈패스트(VinFast)의 최신 판매 실적을 종합하면 8월 한 달간 전체 시장 판매량은 4만8,484대로 전월 대비 17% 급감했다. 올 들어 월별로 업계 전체 판매량이 감소한 것은 이번이 5번째로, 특히 8월 판매량은 뗏 연휴가 있던 2월에 이어 두 번째로 낮은 수준이다. 자동차 업계는 지난달 부진한 신차 판매가 고가 자산 구매를 꺼리는 음력 7월이 끼어있었기 때문이라고 입을 모았다. 실제로 일부 고객들은 계약은 체결했지만 차량 인도나 번호판 등록을 미룬 것으로 나타났다. 베트남에서 음력 7월은 ‘귀신의 달’로 불운한 시기를 의미해, 이 때는 집이나 차량 같은 고가품 구매를 자제하는 것은 물론, 결혼 등도 꺼리는 경향이 짙게 나타난다. 올 들어 월별 판매량은 들쭉날쭉한 모습을 보이고 있지만, 8월 기준 신차 판매량은 누적 43만2,548대로 전년 동기 대비 26.4% 늘어난 수준을 유지했다. 특히 빈패스트는 전기차로만 15만4,000여 대를 판매하며 전체 시장 성장세를 주도했다. 구체적으로, 8월 기준 빈패스트의 전기차 인도 대수는 누적 14만4,073대를 기록했다. 이는 전년 동기 대비 71% 이상 증가한 것으로, 업계 전체 성장률의 2.7배에 달하는 수준이다. 다음으로 VAMA와 일부 수입차 브랜드 판매량은 24만6,935대로 11.9% 증가한 반면, 현대차 판매량은 3만1,540대(+34대)로 사실상 제자리걸음에 그쳤다. 빈패스트는 판매 차종이 모두 순수전기차(BEV)로 구성된 반면, VAMA와 현대차는 내연기관차와 하이브리드들로 주로 구성돼 있다. 업계 전체 판매 실적은 내연기관차와 전기차가 혼재돼 있지만, 빈패스트의 성장세를 감안하면, 실제 시장 성장을 주도한 것은 전기차였음을 알 수 있다. 올 들어 베트남 신차 판매량은 월평균 약 5만4,000대를 기록하고 있다. 올해 남은 기간 현재의 추세가 이어진다면, 전체 신차 판매량은 64만8,800대를 넘어 역대 최고치를 경신할 것으로 기대를 모은다.
